privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: Optimal Vitality Institute ('OVI Wellness') values your privacy. This policy details how we collect, protect, and handle your medical and personal information under HIPAA and applicable privacy laws.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.text: We collect personal identification details (name, email, phone) and medical history forms provided when booking a consultation or filling out diagnostic intake forms.

sections.heading: 2. How Information Is Used
sections.text: Your information is used strictly by our medical providers to evaluate treatment candidacy, schedule lab panels, and manage your custom protocols. We never sell your personal data.

sections.heading: 3. HIPAA Security & Protection
sections.text: All health records and electronic communications are encrypted and stored in HIPAA-compliant electronic health record (EHR) systems.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: By using this website and booking services with Optimal Vitality Institute, you agree to the following terms.

sections.heading: 1. Medical Evaluation Requirement
sections.text: All medical protocols (TRT, GLP-1, Peptides) require explicit physician evaluation, laboratory blood testing, and continuous clinical oversight.

sections.heading: 2. Payment & Membership Terms
sections.text: Fees for diagnostic lab panels and prescription therapies are disclosed prior to enrollment. Subscriptions and protocol renewals may be managed via patient portal.
